# About Me

## Identity
I am a Product Manager working on billing and revenue operations for mid-market SaaS.
I think in user outcomes, not feature lists. My focus this year is reducing involuntary churn,
which is the largest recoverable revenue loss in the business and the one nobody owns.

## My Frameworks
- Prioritization: RICE (Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort)
- Discovery: Jobs-to-be-Done
- Metrics: North Star Metric + L1/L2 metrics tree
- Communication: Pyramid principle — conclusion first, rationale after

## How I Decide
Evidence first. If a claim has no number or no quote behind it, it is a hypothesis and gets
labelled as one. I would rather ship a smaller thing I can measure.

## Output Format Defaults
- Lead with the recommendation, then rationale
- Markdown headers and tables in documents; bullets for 3+ items
- Concise: one sentence beats two; prose paragraphs 3 sentences max
- Ask one clarifying question when intent is ambiguous — never guess
